title: Add kindSchemas validator regression tests for FeatureChoice requiresOption/optional
description: eshyra-mdke.1 added requiresOption (sibling must exist and list optionId) and optional:true validation in optFeatureChoiceArray (kindSchemas.ts). It is exercised only via the real pack and the importer guard tests; add focused negative validator tests (missing sibling, optionId not in sibling from, optional:false).
